svg.title: Bytes read per factor coupling
svg.desc: Bytes per factor coupling: standard FP64 FSAI reads 12 bytes, mirrored FP16 reads 4 bytes, and BitFSAI reads 1 byte.

svg.text: BitFSAI also stores 8 B per row for the FP32 diagonal and scale. Across 8 workloads, it uses 4.23x to 6.84x

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: less smoother storage than a standard FP64 factor on the same K <= 16 pattern, counting values and int32 indices.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: One FP64 entry plus its int32 index pulls 12 bytes from DRAM for 2 floating-point operations.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: Arithmetic intensity sits under 0.17 FLOP/byte, two orders of magnitude below GPU compute throughput.
